subject: Facility location benchmarks: 40x fewer recomputations, memory risk
body:
Hi Alina,

Benchmark status. The library compiles clean with -O2 and we replicated the paper's headline: against greedy recomputation, the agreement-based algorithm gives comparable clustering cost with roughly 40x fewer recomputations on our sliding-window instances (sliding_window_size 100k, 10% of points as facilities, random_order on).

Parameter picks so far: num_levels_slack (the paper's beta) at 3 and epsilon (the lambda parameter) at 0.1 are the stability sweet spot; below that, assignments churn.

Risk: memory. At target_num_nodes of 10M points in 128 dimensions the resident set hits 92GB, over our standard benchmark hosts. Options: sharding, or the 256GB hosts Emeka found. Recommend the latter for now.

Tereza
